profile_text.body:
Sierra is a San Francisco-based company founded in 2023 that describes itself as helping businesses build better, more human customer experiences with AI. The company's own site frames its focus not purely as automation but as delivering experiences that, in its words, still feel personal and thoughtful.

Sierra's primary product, also called Sierra, is categorized as an enterprise AI platform and agent orchestration tool built for conversational AI in customer experience settings. The held facts confirm Sierra has a tracked presence on theworldofai.org, with its profile verified as of August 2026, and no recorded litigation or MCP server registrations at this time. The company does carry a notable California legal-exposure count of 161, which may reflect regulatory or filing activity in that state consistent with its San Francisco headquarters.
